rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi --no-recursive
export GLIB_CFLAGS="-I$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/glib-2.0 -I$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/glib-2.0/include" export GLIB_LIBS="-lglib-2.0"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-nls
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
if [ -e "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" ]; then rm "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/pkg-config" else mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/pkg-config" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" fi
